aboutText:
UTCar is a pioneering automotive research and innovation platform dedicated to developing sustainable and cutting-edge vehicle technologies. Our team of engineers and researchers work collaboratively to design innovative solutions that push the boundaries of performance, safety, and environmental responsibility.
We strive to create vehicles that are not only efficient and technologically advanced but also accessible and user-friendly. Through rigorous testing, community engagement, and continuous learning, UTCar aims to shape the future of transportation and inspire the next generation of automotive enthusiasts.
aboutsensor: High-precision sensors and AI-driven decision making.
aboutinno: Cutting-edge autonomous technology for safer roads.
decisionmaking: Developing intelligent decision-making algorithms for autonomous systems.
simulation: Creating virtual environments to test robot behavior and system performance.
sensorp: Integrating cameras, IMUs, LIDAR and other sensors for real-time data collection.
hardware: Assembling electronics, mechanical parts, and embedded systems into final robots.
cv: Using computer vision modules to precieve the environment and make low level decisions.
cvIntro:
We design computer vision modules to percieve the environment and extract meaningful information from the sensors. Afterwards, this information is used to make both low level and high level decision making.
 Our computer vision pipeline consists of 3 modules.
